correctness.rationale: From the actual RESULTS.md, two-token adjacency is exclusively between pure and mixed pairs. In any maximal independent set, letting U,V be pure-uncovered host vertices, all U×V mixed pairs must appear; all pure pairs inside complements must appear. Consistency forbids a singleton covered side, giving U_s={1,..,s} without s-1 and the all-pure exception. The derived size identity F=C(m,2)+u(n-m)+(b-u)(b-u-1)/2 proves minimum and all equality multiplicities, with (2,2) exceptional. Independent bitset maximality enumeration on four small hosts reproduced the entire polynomial and T values. Tests are finite; structural argument proves all m,n.
